<div class="card-body">
'''Physical Choke''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">絞殺</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">次のうちどちらかを選ぶ。１：任意の反乱軍の兵員／トルーパー１名を即座にロストさせる。２：ダーク・ジェダイを参加させた戦闘に勝った直後に使う。１フォース消費して、戦闘に参加した相手のキャラクターを１名選ぶ。運命数を引き、運命数＞対象の能力値なら、対象はロストする。</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ダース・ベイダーは、尋問の際、少々物理的な手段を取ることもある。タンティヴィIVのアンティリズ艦長は、デス・スターの設計図のありかを吐くよりも、死を選んだ。</span>''

<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Strangulation.<ref name="photo" />

'''Card text:''' Choose either of the following. 1: Immediately cause any one Rebel soldier/trooper to be lost. 2: Use immediately after winning a battle in which a Dark Jedi participated. Use 1 Force and choose one opposing character who participated in the battle. Draw destiny; if the destiny is greater than the target's ability, the target is lost.<ref name="photo" />

'''Lore:''' Darth Vader sometimes resorts to somewhat physical methods during interrogation. Captain Antilles of Tantive IV chose death rather than reveal the whereabouts of the Death Star plans.<ref name="photo" />

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese first option says one Rebel soldier/trooper; the English names one [[Rebel Trooper]]. In the second option the Japanese describes a Dark Jedi and opposing character who participated in the battle, while the English uses present for both. The English expressly calls the action an attempt to choke; the Japanese describes choosing the character and resolving the destiny comparison. The Japanese lore omits the English description of the Death Star plans as stolen.<ref name="comparison-video">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=328 Physical Choke Japanese and English printed faces], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 5:28.</ref>

<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Physical Choke]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="photo">[https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/star-wars-ccg-japanese-premiere/imagegallery/29544 Japanese Premiere collector gallery], PSA; [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/157510088/9fXD1tWf-ECUgR1zKNQOcg.jpg Physical Choke original photograph].</ref>
